en.basel-kadem: 1.	My father, may Allah grant him mercy, said: We were told by Sa’d bin Abdullah, from Ahmad bin Muhammed, from his father, from Fadala, from Aban, from Abu’l-Jaroud, from Abu Ja’far, peace be upon him,

with regards to the saying of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He: «Indeed, you are of an exalted moral character.» [68:4] He said: It is Islam. It was also reported that exalted moral character is the Exalted Religion.
